protagonist.name: Maya
protagonist.description: young scientist with short black hair, white lab coat

video_prompts.prompt: Interior of a minimalist, brightly lit laboratory. Maya, a young scientist with short black hair, white lab coat, stands before a holographic interface. Floating in the air are glowing, translucent blocks representing equation components: 'a1', 'x', 'b1', 'y', 'c1'. With precise hand gestures, Maya slides the blocks into a linear sequence, forming the equation 'a1x + b1y + c1 = 0'. The assembled equation solidifies into a flat, glowing blue plane of light that extends infinitely. The camera performs a slow orbital motion around the floating equation, showing its structure from multiple angles. The final frame is a direct shot of the complete general form, glowing brightly in the center of the screen.

Maya, a young scientist with short black hair, white lab coat, observes a large, dark screen divided into three vertical sections. In the left section, a red line and a blue line of light are drawn, intersecting at a single, bright point. In the middle section, two parallel green lines are drawn; they move together but never touch. In the right section, a yellow line is drawn, and then a second yellow line traces over it perfectly, merging into a single, thicker, intensely glowing line. The camera slowly pans from left to right, pausing on each of the three scenarios. The final frame is a wide shot showing all three graphical solutions—intersecting, parallel, and coincident—side-by-side on the screen.

In a lab, Maya, a young scientist with short black hair, white lab coat, examines two interconnected glass containers representing equations. From the first container, she uses a mechanical arm to extract a glowing blue orb labeled 'y = 5 - x'. She carefully moves the orb across the scene and inserts it into a designated port on the second container, which holds the equation '2x + 3[ ] = 13'. Upon insertion, the second container flashes, and the internal components rearrange until a single, solid, red crystal representing 'x = 2' materializes at the bottom. The camera dollies in on this crystal. The final frame is a macro shot of the 'x = 2' crystal, glowing with a solved intensity.

Maya, a young scientist with short black hair, white lab coat, points to a physical model of two parallel train tracks on a large table, representing equations with no solution. The tracks have identical slopes, illustrating 'a1/a2 = b1/b2'. However, one track has a different starting elevation, representing 'c1/c2' being unequal. Two small, synchronized magnetic carts start moving along the tracks. They travel at the same speed and maintain the same distance apart but never meet because they are on separate, parallel paths. The camera follows the carts, then cranes up to show the entire parallel track system. The final frame is an aerial top-down view, emphasizing the permanent separation between the two tracks, signifying no solution.

In a darkened room, Maya, a young scientist with short black hair, white lab coat, holds two devices that each project a perfectly straight, red laser beam. She aims them so they cross at a single point in the center of the room. She then tries to adjust the devices to make the beams intersect at a second point without bending them. The beams pivot, but remain straight, demonstrating they can only intersect once or become parallel or coincident. A slow-motion shot follows one beam past the intersection point, showing its unwavering straight path into the distance. A crane shot rises to show the geometric plane. The final frame shows the two straight beams crossing at exactly one point, with text overlay: 'Two straight lines, one intersection.'
